prompt_for_image_ai:
Square 640×640 flat vector illustration. ONE young Filipino man — The Visionary.

ART STYLE:
- Clean 2D vector, unDraw edu style
- Thin black outlines (~2px) on figure, blazer, megaphone, folder — color #2D2D2D
- Flat solid fills — NO crayon, NO pencil, NO 3D, NO chibi
- Face: dot eyes, confident smile, minimal features
- Realistic young-adult proportions

BACKGROUND:
- Solid cream #FDFCF8 full square
- Soft coral #FF8A65 wash behind shoulders (~20% opacity)
- Optional faint grey circles
- NO text, NO letter E, NO frame, NO border

COMPOSITION — MOST IMPORTANT:
- Bust portrait: head + shoulders + upper chest + blazer only — STOP at mid-torso/ribcage
- Do NOT draw waist, hips, or lower body
- Character SMALL and centered (~55% width, ~60% height)
- At least 25% empty cream below blazer hem — nothing touches bottom edge
- ~10% empty cream above hair
- NO floor line, NO ground, NO horizontal black bar, NO bottom crop
- Full megaphone and folder must be 100% inside frame with margin

CHARACTER:
- Light olive skin, short neat black hair
- White collared shirt, coral blazer #FF8A65
- Confident friendly energy

PROPS:
- Right hand: coral megaphone at cheek/mouth — entire megaphone visible, not cut off
- Left arm: slim coral folder tucked at upper chest — simple white upward-arrow icon on cover (no words)
- Props held high at chest level, not hanging toward bottom

REJECT IF: bottom cut off, floor line, props clipped, or hand-drawn/crayon style.
